# Smart Flow Engineering

> Industrial Automation & Electrical Engineering Solutions

Drives • Controls • Electrical

Integrate. Install. Upgrade.

Smart Flow Engineering supports system integrators, OEMs, contractors and industrial operators with industrial electrical installation, automation integration, drives and control upgrades, testing and commissioning.

## Engineering Services

- [Industrial Electrical Engineering](https://smartfloweng.com/electrical-meica.html): Site installation, modifications and electrical completion for industrial equipment and project work packages.
- [Drives & Motor Control](https://smartfloweng.com/drives-motion.html): Assessment, replacement and retrofit support for AC/DC drives and motor-control equipment.
- [Automation & Controls](https://smartfloweng.com/automation-control.html): PLC, HMI and control-system upgrade and integration support for existing machinery and plant.
- [System Integration & Installation](https://smartfloweng.com/services.html): Connecting new equipment with existing machinery, controls and site infrastructure within an agreed scope.
- [Testing & Commissioning](https://smartfloweng.com/testing-commissioning.html): Structured verification, start-up assistance and handover support for electrical and automation installations.
- [Maintenance & Reliability Support](https://smartfloweng.com/technical-support.html): Planned support after installation and during outages to help keep industrial equipment supportable.

## Who We Support

[Who We Support](https://smartfloweng.com/who-we-support.html)

- Tier 1 & industrial contractors: Specialist electrical and automation work packages, installation completion, testing and commissioning support.
- System integrators: Additional site engineering capacity for electrical installation, controls integration, I/O testing and commissioning.
- OEMs & machine builders: UK site support for machinery installation, electrical integration, drive and control upgrades, testing and customer handover.
- Industrial operators & asset owners: Practical engineering support for equipment upgrades, electrical modifications, control improvements, shutdowns and planned maintenance.

## Delivery Arrangements

Based in Loughton. Project location, engineering availability, supervision, responsibilities and any partner-supported activities are agreed for each work package. Pearlcon is our parent company; its projects and leadership experience are distinct from Smart Flow’s operating history. Sprint Electric technology training does not imply a completed Smart Flow project reference. KOSMEK product suitability, supply and integration arrangements are confirmed for each enquiry.
